title: Insurer and regulator briefing
context: RideBelt is an open, safety-critical Hee-Lee Oss project: an optional rider-worn backup restraint (low hip belt + short tethers; optional clip-on Shoulder Module or one-piece Integrated Harness) that latches into an open seat anchor standard (RAS). ALL safety content is DRAFT and not for use until a credentialed engineer signs off at the MVP gate (GOVERNANCE.md). Never remove a DRAFT banner, never give instructions for wearing or attaching anything to a ride, never copy text from paid standards (cite by number and title only), never name private individuals or incident victims, and respect the patent design-arounds in docs/research/patentability-fto.md. Insurers (premium credits) and ride regulators are key adopters (stakeholders.md).
objective: Write a two-page briefing for amusement-industry insurers and state ride regulators: evidence, the independent-secondary-restraint framing in F2291, the certification plan, and the asks.
